title: PersonCreated v1
description: A person was created in the Person Service. An EventBridge Pipe publishes it from the Persons table stream to the person-events-{stage} bus. The event is thin: it identifies the person and carries no personal data. Delivery is at-least-once, so the same event can arrive more than once: consumers must be idempotent on detail.metadata.eventId.

eventId.description: The eventID of the DynamoDB stream record. It stays the same when the record is delivered again, unlike the EventBridge envelope id. Deduplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the person was created, in UTC.

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the request that created the person. Caller-supplied through the X-Correlation-Id header (or generated). It is broadcast to every subscriber and archived, so callers must not put personal data in it.
